moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest surf and music festival, Boardmasters, returns to Cornwall from August 5th-9th, featuring headliners like Fatboy Slim, Lily Allen, and The Kooks.

angles.name: Festival Excitement
angles.copy: Boardmasters is nearly here! Who are you most excited to see hit the stages at Watergate Bay and Fistral Beach this week? Let us know!

angles.name: Cornwall Calling
angles.copy: Cornwall is gearing up for Boardmasters! Surfing, music, and good vibes take over Newquay from Wednesday. If you're heading down, stay safe and have an amazing time!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, opens its doors on August 7th, bringing thousands of shows across comedy, theatre, music, and more to Scotland's capital.

angles.name: Fringe Fever
angles.copy: Edinburgh Fringe is back this Friday! Three weeks of incredible talent, unexpected moments, and a whole lot of laughs (and gasps). What are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Scotland's Spotlight
angles.copy: The eyes of the arts world turn to Scotland this week as the Edinburgh Fringe Festival begins! Get ready for an explosion of creativity across the city.

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday in Scotland
moments.blurb: Today marks the Summer Bank Holiday in Scotland, offering many a long weekend to enjoy the start of August.

angles.name: Enjoy the Day Off
angles.copy: Happy Summer Bank Holiday to everyone in Scotland! Whether you're relaxing or out exploring, hope you're having a fantastic day!

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: It's a Bank Holiday Monday north of the border! What are your plans for this extra day off in Scotland?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off Soon
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to begin on Friday, August 21st, with fixtures having been released in June.

angles.name: Football Countdown
angles.copy: Less than three weeks to go until the Premier League kicks off! Who's ready for another season of drama, goals, and unforgettable moments?

angles.name: Anticipation Builds
angles.copy: Pre-season is in full swing, but the real action starts August 21st! Which team are you backing for the 2026/27 Premier League title?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield will take place on Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal against FA Cup holders Manchester City.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Shield
angles.copy: Cardiff is getting ready to host the Community Shield next Sunday! Who will lift the first silverware of the season, Arsenal or Man City?

angles.name: Welsh Football Focus
angles.copy: Big football action coming to Principality Stadium next weekend as the Community Shield takes place in Cardiff! Are you heading along?

moments.title: Happy 63rd to James Hetfield
moments.blurb: James Hetfield, co-founder, frontman, and rhythm guitarist of the legendary heavy metal band Metallica, turns 63 today.

angles.name: Metal Legend
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the iconic James Hetfield of Metallica! What's your all-time favourite Metallica track?

angles.name: Rhythm King
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the legendary rhythm guitarist and voice of Metallica, James Hetfield! Still rocking harder than ever at 63!

moments.title: Happy 59th to Skin of Skunk Anansie
moments.blurb: Deborah Anne Dyer, better known as Skin, the powerful lead singer of British rock band Skunk Anansie, celebrates her 59th birthday today.

angles.name: Skunk Anansie Icon
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the incredible Skin, the unmistakable voice of Skunk Anansie! What's your favourite song by the band?

angles.name: Rock Powerhouse
angles.copy: Wishing a fierce Happy Birthday to Skin! The Skunk Anansie frontwoman turns 59 today, continuing to inspire with her powerful vocals and stage presence.

moments.title: Happy 65th to Lee Rocker
moments.blurb: Lee Rocker, the influential upright bassist and co-founder of the rockabilly revival band Stray Cats, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Rockabilly King
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to the one and only Lee Rocker of Stray Cats! Still keeping that rockabilly beat alive.

angles.name: Stray Cats Groove
angles.copy: From 'Stray Cat Strut' to 'Rock This Town,' Lee Rocker's basslines are iconic! Wishing the Stray Cats legend a very Happy 65th Birthday!

moments.title: Happy 63rd to Tasmin Archer
moments.blurb: British pop singer Tasmin Archer, best known for her 1992 hit single 'Sleeping Satellite', turns 63 today.

angles.name: Sleeping Satellite Singer
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 63rd Birthday to Tasmin Archer! 'Sleeping Satellite' is still a classic, isn't it?

angles.name: 90s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to the voice behind one of the biggest 90s hits, Tasmin Archer! Still love 'Sleeping Satellite' after all these years.

moments.title: Happy 85th to Beverly Lee of The Shirelles
moments.blurb: Beverly Lee, a founding member of the iconic American girl group The Shirelles, who gave us hits like 'Will You Love Me Tomorrow,' celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Girl Group Legend
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to Beverly Lee of the legendary Shirelles! Still loving 'Will You Love Me Tomorrow' and all their timeless tracks.

angles.name: Motown Sound
angles.copy: Celebrating the 85th Birthday of Beverly Lee, a true pioneer of the girl group sound with The Shirelles. Their music is still pure magic!

moments.title: Tribute to Louis Armstrong (would be 125)
moments.blurb: August 4th marks what would have been the 125th birthday of the legendary jazz trumpeter and singer Louis Armstrong, born in New Orleans in 1901.

angles.name: Satchmo's Legacy
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we remember the incredible Louis Armstrong, who would have been 125. His music truly made the world a wonderful place.

angles.name: Jazz Icon
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Louis Armstrong on what would be his 125th birthday tomorrow. A true pioneer of jazz, his influence is still felt today.

moments.title: Happy 68th to Ian Broudie
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, the English singer-songwriter, musician, and producer best known as the frontman of The Lightning Seeds, celebrates his 68th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Lightning Seeds Maestro
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 68th Birthday to Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds tomorrow! From 'Three Lions' to 'The Life of Riley', his songs are anthems.

angles.name: Indie Pop Legend
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Ian Broudie's 68th Birthday tomorrow! The creative force behind The Lightning Seeds, responsible for some truly timeless indie pop.

moments.title: Happy 79th to Ian Anderson
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, the Scottish musician, singer, and songwriter, best known as the frontman of the progressive rock band Jethro Tull, turns 79 on August 10th.

angles.name: Prog Rock Flautist
angles.copy: Next Monday, we celebrate the 79th Birthday of the legendary Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull! What's your favourite Tull track?

angles.name: Jethro Tull Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a future Happy 79th Birthday to the iconic Ian Anderson, master flautist and leader of Jethro Tull, next week!

moments.title: Happy 62nd to Neneh Cherry
moments.blurb: Swedish singer-songwriter and rapper Neneh Cherry, known for hits like 'Buffalo Stance' and 'Manchild', celebrates her 62nd birthday on August 10th.

angles.name: Genre-Bending Star
angles.copy: Next Monday, a very Happy 62nd Birthday to the fantastic Neneh Cherry! Her influence on pop, hip-hop, and dance is undeniable.

angles.name: Still a Buffalo Stance
angles.copy: Celebrating Neneh Cherry's 62nd Birthday next week! Still loving her unique style and incredible music.

moments.title: Happy 58th to Michael Bivins
moments.blurb: Michael Bivins, a founding member of the iconic R&B groups New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe, turns 58 on August 10th.

angles.name: New Edition Legend
angles.copy: Poison! That's the jam! Happy 58th Birthday next Monday to Michael Bivins of New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe!

angles.name: R&B Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of R&B legend Michael Bivins next week! From 'Candy Girl' to 'Poison', his impact is huge.

moments.title: Happy 77th to Mark Knopfler
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, the legendary Scottish guitarist, singer, and songwriter, best known as the lead guitarist and frontman of Dire Straits, turns 77 on August 12th.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Next Wednesday, a very Happy 77th Birthday to the incomparable Mark Knopfler! His guitar work with Dire Straits is pure magic.

angles.name: Dire Straits Icon
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to 'Money for Nothing', Mark Knopfler's influence is immense. Wishing him a Happy 77th Birthday next week!

moments.title: Happy 65th to Roy Hay
moments.blurb: Roy Hay, the guitarist and keyboardist for the iconic 80s new wave band Culture Club, celebrates his 65th birthday on August 12th.

angles.name: Culture Club Groove
angles.copy: Do you really want to hurt him? We don't! Happy 65th Birthday next Wednesday to Roy Hay of Culture Club!

angles.name: 80s Pop Star
angles.copy: Celebrating Roy Hay's 65th Birthday next week! The man behind some of Culture Club's greatest sounds.

moments.title: Happy 63rd to Sir Mix-A-Lot
moments.blurb: Anthony Ray, better known as the Grammy Award-winning rapper Sir Mix-A-Lot, famous for his 1992 hit 'Baby Got Back', turns 63 on August 12th.

angles.name: Baby Got Back Rapper
angles.copy: Oh my god, Becky, look at his birthday! Happy 63rd Birthday next Wednesday to the one and only Sir Mix-A-Lot!

angles.name: 90s Hip Hop Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating Sir Mix-A-Lot's 63rd Birthday next week! Still a massive hit-maker and a true 90s icon.

moments.title: Happy 42nd to James Morrison
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for his soulful voice and hits like 'You Give Me Something' and 'Broken Strings', turns 42 on August 12th.

angles.name: Soulful Singer
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 42nd Birthday next Wednesday to the incredibly talented James Morrison! His voice is pure gold.

angles.name: Modern Classic
angles.copy: From 'You Give Me Something' to 'Broken Strings', James Morrison's music always hits different. Happy 42nd Birthday next week!
